deadline.value: Applicants are reviewed monthly from December 15 in a two-step process.
deadline.quote: We will review applicants on a monthly basis starting December 15th.

gre_subject.value: The admissions page does not state a GRE rule.

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not state whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: All PhD students receive full funding covering tuition, health insurance and a stipend.
funding.quote: 100% of our PhD graduate students receive full funding, including tuition, health insurance, and a competitive stipend

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's degree is needed.

fee_waiver.value: Short-listed applicants are invited to submit the full application with a fee waiver; this is not a promise of admission.
fee_waiver.quote: Students who show great promise and exhibit our values will be encouraged to submit their full application and be provided with an application fee waiver.

notes: The two-step process starts with a first-stage application; the fee waiver is for applicants invited to the full application.
